citations.passage:
The linearity assumption behind d-004 does not hold for archival material;
batching and preprocessing now set the schedule, not API capacity.

Later contradicted by the latency benchmark in
s-006, which found archival page scans far below the assumed rate.

judge.rationale: The agent identifies the s-006 latency benchmark as contradicting d-004 and accurately reports its findings: throughput was roughly 40% of the assumed rate on real archival scans after preprocessing, disproving linearity for archival material and making batching and preprocessing—not API capacity—the schedule drivers.
